orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice V. K. Bist
orders.text:
WPSS 2368 of 2017 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
 
Mr. S.C. Bhatt, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
 Mr. N.P. Sah, Standing Counsel for 
the State. 
 Mr. C.K. Sharma, Advocate for 
respondent nos.5 and 6. 
 Smt. Hari Sati, Principal of G.P.P. 
Kanya Inter College, Ramnagar, District 
Nainital is present in person. 
 Mr. C.K. Sharma, learned counsel 
for respondent nos.5 and 6 has supplied 
copy of the appointment file, which 
reveals that there were 03 members in 
the Selection Committee, namely, Sharad 
Jindal, Manager, Smt. Hari Sati, 
Principal and Mr. Bhaskaranand Pandey, 
Block Education Officer, Ramnagar. They 
three have given marks to the selected 
candidate Neha Sharma (respondent 
no.7 herein) in the written examination 
as follows: 
 18 20 18 
Whereas marks given to the petitioner 
are as follows: 
 22 14 12 
 From the perusal of page 68 column 
6 of the appointment file, it would reveal 
that there is overwriting on the marks 
awarded to respondent no.7. It appears 
that initially it was written as 10, but 
after overwriting, it was written as 20. 
 Let copy of Page 68 of the 
record/appointment file be taken on 
record. 
 Chief Education Officer, Nainital, 
shall produce the entire original record of 
the case on the next date.   Respondent no.4-C.E.O. Nainital, 
respondent no.6-Smt. Hari Sati and Mr. 
Bhaskaranand Pandey, the then Block 
Education Officer, Ramnagar, shall 
remain present in person before this 
Court on 09.05.2018 and shall also file 
their separate counter affidavits 
indicating why separate papers of typing 
tests were given to different candidates. 
 List on 09.05.2018. 
 
(Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
 02.05.2018 
Rajni

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice V. K. Bist
orders.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL 
 WPSS No. 2368 of 2017 
 With 
 CLMA No.10348 of 2017 
 IA No.3149 of 2018 
Smt. Anju Agarwal ..… Petitioner. 
Versus 
State of Uttarakhand & others ..… Respondents. 
Mr. Suresh Chandra Bhatt, Advocate for the petitioner. 
Mr. C.S. Rawat, Addl. Chief Standing Counsel for the State. 
Mr. C.K. Sharma, Advocate for respondent no.5 & 6. 
 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
 Mr. K.K. Gupta, Chief Education Officer, 
Nainital alongwitih Respondent no.6 Smt. Hari Sati 
and Mr. Bhaskaranand Pandey, Block Education 
Officer, Ramnagar and Mr. Sharad Jindal, Manager 
of the Institution are present in person. 
2. Mr. Sharad Jindal makes a statement 
that the different papers for typing test were 
prepared as there were only three computers. He 
submits that he is not aware as to how many 
candidates participated in the typing test. On this, 
Mr. C.K. Sharma, Advocate interrupted and 
prompted the Manager about the actual position. 
The conduct of Mr. C.K. Sharma, Advocate is 
against the professional ethics. He prompted him 
that as if manager Mr. Sharad Jindal is not aware 
as to how many candidates appeared, but he 
prompted him that there were 13 candidates. Then 
the Manager stated that there were 13 candidates 
and only three computers. So separate papers were 
prepared for the reasons that the candidates who 
firstly appeared in the typing test may not disclose 
to other candidates who are appearing later for the 
typing test. No prudent person can believe on the 
statement of Mr. Sharad Jindal as for a single post 
when 13 candidates are appearing, a candidate who 
appeared first in the typing test will disclose to 
other candidates because it will directly affect the 
chance of her own selection. It appears to this Court 
that Mr. Sharad Jindal has made false statement 
before this Court to protect the appointment of 
respondent no.7.  2
3. The interview tabulation is produced in 
original shape by the Chief Education Officer, 
Nainital, and the same is taken on record and kept 
in sealed cover. From the perusal of the marks 
awarded in Column No.7 to selected candidate Smt. 
Neha Sharma initially the same appears to be 10 
and subsequently it was made 20 by Smt. Hari Sati, 
Principal of the G.P.P. Kanya Inter College, 
Ramnager, District Nainital. 
4. The Present Chief Education Officer 
submits that at that time he was not there and 
approval of Smt. Neha Sharma was made by Mr. 
Raghunath Aggarwal, the then Chief Education 
Officer. Mr. Vijay Chandra Pandey the then 
Principal submits that at the time of conducting the 
typing test he was present in the examination hall 
and 13 candidates appeared for the typing test. He 
submits that for 13 candidates 5 paper sets were 
prepared. The typing papers were randomly given to 
the candidates. Mohan Chander Pandey, the expert 
from the Private Audhyogik Prasikshan Sansthan, 
Ram Nagar, District Nainital was called as an 
expert. 
5. While the Court was making query from 
Mr. Vijay Chandra Pandey, Mr. Sharad Jindal made 
efforts to improve the statement of Mr. Vijay 
Chandra Pandey. The expert was called from the 
Private Audhyogik Prasikshan Sansthan, Ram 
Nagar, District Nainital. Mr. Vijay Chandra Pandey, 
further submits that there is a Government 
Audhyogik Sansthan in Ram Nagar. But it again 
creates a doubt on the functioning of respondents in 
appointment of respondent no.7 Smt. Neha Sharma 
that instead of calling expert for typing test from the 
Government Audhyogik Prashikshan Sansthan, the 
expert from the private body was called, so that the 
respondents in connivance with each other may 
succeed in appointing a candidate of their choice. It 
is not a private institution where appointment of 
respondent no.7 was made on the post of clerk, the 
salary is to be paid from the State funds and this 
Court is of the firm opinion that it is a clear case of 
giving appointment to respondent No. 7 Smt. Neha 
Sharma by extending undue benefit to her and 
ignoring the other candidates.  3
6. From the perusal of selection record, it 
would reveal that following are the educational 
qualifications of the selected candidate, petitioner 
and other candidates are reproduced hereunder:- 
1) Neha Sharma - i) High School, 
2004 (IIIrd Division) 
ii) Intermediate, 2006 
(IInd Division) 
iii) Graduation, 2009 (IInd 
Division) 
iv) Post Graduation in 
Psychology, 2011(Ist 
Division) 
2)Km.Faizi Khanam- i) High School, 
Intermediate and B.Sc. Ist 
Class in all. 
3)Km.Deepali Singh- ii) High School, 
Intermediate and B.Sc. 
throughout Ist Class. 
7. As per the advertisement, the 
qualification for the post of Assistant Clerk was 
intermediate, Computer-M.S. Office, speed of 25 
words per minute in Hindi Typing. The petitioner 
Smt. Anju Agarwal is having the qualification of six 
months computer application course and one year 
course in Hindi Stenography and Typing and 
experience of 3 years as Computer Operator-cum￾Office Assistant. Whereas the selected candidate 
Smt. Neha Sharma is not having the requisite 
qualification in view of the advertisement issued by 
the respondents. The appointment of respondent 
no.7 has been made in clandestine manner 
ignoring the requisite qualification. From the 
perusal of the entire record produced by the 
Manager of the Institution and Chief Education 
Officer, Nainital, prima facie, it would reveal that 
the respondent nos. 1 to 6 have made illegal 
appointment of respondent no.7. 
8. From the perusal of the interview 
tabulation whereupon there is overwriting and by 
overwriting 10 marks is made as 20 marks. Prima 
facie, it appears to this court that all the members 
of the Selection Committee manipulated the  4
documents just to give undue benefits of 
appointment to respondent no.7. 
9. Respondent no.6 Smt. Hari Sati shall give 
the details of all the appointment made in the 
college and shall also apprise this Court whether 
the reservation policy of the State Government in 
appointment on reserved posts is adhered to or not. 
10. Learned counsel for the petitioner is 
directed to implead the Central Bureau of 
Investigation (C.B.I.) as respondent no.8 during the 
course of the day so that the matter be sent to 
C.B.I. for investigation in the matter. 
11. The entire documents produced by the 
respondents are taken on record and kept in sealed 
cover. The C.B.I. is directed to investigate into the 
matter. The documents kept in a sealed cover shall 
be made available by the Registry of this Court to 
C.B.I. whenever required by the Investigating 
Agency. 
12. Mr. Sandeep Tandon, Special Counsel for 
the C.B.I. is present in the Court. Counsel for the 
petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the petition 
to Mr. Sandeep Tandon, Advocate. 
13. This Court has directed that the C.B.I. 
shall conduct an inquiry in the matter of 
appointment of respondent no. 7 and the 
involvement of the persons and shall submit its 
report within four months before this Court for 
appropriate action. 
14. At this stage, personal appearance of the 
officers concerned is exempted at this juncture. In 
case their presence is required by this court they 
will be summoned to appear in person. 
15. It is further directed that the then Chief 
Education Officer, Nainital, Mr. Raghunath Lal 
Arya, now who has been posted as Joint Director, 
SCERT, Dehradun shall file his personal affidavit 
showing the reasons of according his approval 
without going through the record.  5
16. Issue notice to respondent no.7 fixing 
14.06.2018. 
17. Steps to be taken within a week. 
18. Respondents may file their counter 
affidavit(s) till the next date of listing. 
19. Copy of the order be supplied to Mr. 
Sandeep Tandon, Counsel for the C.B.I., for 
compliance within 24 hours. 
 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
 09.05.2018 
Sukhbant/ Shiksha
